chat.author: Praveen Gupta
chat.text:
Q1: Fast re-authentication when EAP-AKA′ is the Wi-Fi access method
“Most EAP-AKA′ over Wi-Fi today runs inside IKEv2 to the ePDG, through the Wi-Fi rather than to it. Where EAP-AKA′ is the access method itself, as in trusted non-3GPP access or carrier Wi-Fi, fast re-authentication carries most of the roaming load. Fast re-authentication runs no fresh ephemeral or PQ exchange, and with this draft the first reauth-ID is still sent under a non-FS K_encr. So is PQ and FS protection intended for full authentication only?

chat.author: Praveen Gupta
chat.text:
Q2: Reusable PQ building blocks
“AT_PUB_KEM, AT_KEM_CT, AT_FRAGMENT, the AT_KDF_FS negotiation, and now AT_SUPPORT_TEKS_FS are generic PQ and FS building blocks. Could the WG define them so other AKA-family methods can reuse them? One example is draft-gupta-emu-eap-wsim. It lets MNO devices authenticate to enterprise Wi-Fi with their SIM credential, without a live connection to the MNO core.

chat.author: Praveen Gupta
chat.text: I support solving large PQC SUCI, but fragmentation should be defined once, in a standalone update to RFC 9048, rather than spread across the KEM, SACK and identity drafts. The identity exchange also needs mandatory AT_CHECKCODE to prevent downgrade.
